# omadafusion_wireless_network (Resource)

A WPA-Personal SSID (Wireless Networks). Creating or changing an SSID re-provisions every AP in the WLAN group, which briefly interrupts all SSIDs. The passphrase is stored in state; protect the state file. WLAN schedules are left untouched; manage them with `omadafusion_ssid_schedule`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "staff_wifi_passphrase" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "omadafusion_lan_network" "staff" { name = "Staff" }

resource "omadafusion_wireless_network" "staff" {
  name         = "Clinic Staff"
  passphrase   = var.staff_wifi_passphrase
  network_id   = data.omadafusion_lan_network.staff.id
  bands        = ["2.4ghz", "5ghz"]
  fast_roaming = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SSID name.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) WPA2 passphrase, 8-63 characters.

### Optional

- `bands` (Set of String) Radios to broadcast on: `2.4ghz`, `5ghz`, `6ghz`. Defaults to 2.4 and 5 GHz.
- `broadcast` (Boolean) Broadcast the SSID name.
- `fast_roaming` (Boolean) 802.11r fast roaming.
- `guest_network` (Boolean) Controller guest-network isolation for this SSID.
- `network_id` (String) LAN network to bridge clients into. Omit to use the AP's native (management) VLAN.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `wlan_id` (String) WLAN group ID. Defaults to the site's primary WLAN group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SSID ID.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN the SSID is bridged to, or 0 when untagged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_wireless_network.staff Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
